characters.name: CAPTAIN VIMES
characters.description: The disillusioned leader of the Night Watch. Has a sense of duty and justice drowned in cynicism. Has an aversion to the aristocracy and bureaucracy.

characters.name: CARROT
characters.description: Simple but not stupid. Carrot sees things clearer than most, and not just because he’s over six feet tall. This fresh-faced recruit is ready to enforce the rules that the citizens of Ankh-Morpork assumed were just helpful suggestions.

characters.name: CORPORAL NOBBS
characters.description: Wily is the polite word. Shameless might be more accurate. A member of the Watch, street smart enough to know that surviving Ankh-Morpork means running away from the action.

characters.name: SERGEANT COLON
characters.description: Fred has survived many years on the Watch by ensuring he does not find himself near potential crime scenes. Fuelled by the sandwiches his wife makes, Sergeant Colon strives to survive the streets of Ankh-Morpork with as little fuss as possible.

characters.name: LADY SYBIL RAMKIN
characters.description: If the upper class had an upper class, Lady Sybil would be it. A keen breeder of swamp dragons, who will protect them at any cost. She is no damsel in distress and have mercy on those who would try and kidnap her.

characters.name: FOOTNOTE
characters.description: Less a narrator, more a handy appendix for all things Ankh-Morpork.

characters.name: THE PATRICIAN
characters.description: The key to ruling this city is to ensure you’re a better option than anyone else. Failing that, awkward silences do wonders to remove any doubters, as does the dungeon.

characters.name: THE LIBRARIAN
characters.description: Ook. Eek. Congratulations, you’ve just learnt all of the librarian’s lines! Now how do you feel about orangutans…? (may require someone with sturdy knees for lots of crouching!)

characters.name: THE DRAGON
characters.description: (pre-recorded) They might’ve been summoned but they won’t be controlled. Who needs negotiations when you have size, speed, strength and the ability to eradicate a good few metres of architecture with fiery breath?

characters.name: MEMBERS OF THE ELUCIDATED BRETHREN
characters.description: Would-be rulers of the realm barring a lack of resources, intelligence, competency etc. But the fancy black robes and masks are pretty neat! This secret society will bring the dragon back but who’s going to return it afterwards?
